title: fix(plugin-chatbot): make the documented `surface` key authorable on `chatbot-enhanced`
body:
Fixes #6687

The docs `Properties` table on `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` listed a `surface` row (`'card'` or `'plain'`, "bordered panel or a frameless full-page workspace"), but no `chatbot*` registration read the key. An author who wrote `surface: 'plain'` got the `'card'` default — no error, no signal.

Implements the maintainer ruling of **2026-08-29** (verbatim 「同意」, live director session batch #10): **wire it**, rather than delete the row. Deleting was explicitly not taken — it would hide a real, shipped capability back inside the React component.

## Verification before editing — the zero is the whole card

Re-ran the read-site census on my own base (`26896c689`), with controls in the same query so a zero means "absent" and not "my query was wrong":

| query on `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx` | count | role |
|---|---|---|
| `schema.surface` | **0** | target |
| `schema.placeholder` | 3 | control, one per registration |
| `schema.processVisibility` | 1 | control, enhanced-only key |

Confirmed on a **second, independent declaration face**: `ChatbotSchema` (`packages/types/src/complex.ts:539`) declares 34 keys and not this one. Two faces agreeing is what makes the zero a reading.

`surface` was real only as a prop of the React component — `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` defines `ChatbotSurface` (:445), defaults it to `'card'` (:1328), and branches six layout decisions off `isPlainSurface`.

## Full-table sweep — how many rows survive

The dispatch asked for the whole table swept the same way. **25 rows; 24 survive; `surface` was the only zero-read-point row.**

Two rows are live but reach only a *subset* of the three registrations, and the flat table never says so: `maxHeight` (2 of 3 — `chatbot-floating` gets `floatingConfig.panelHeight` instead) and `processVisibility` (1 of 3 — enhanced only). That is a scope over-claim rather than an inert row, it is true under either resolution of this card, and it is **not** touched here — filed separately as #6824 (a sub-issue of this one), which owns it.

## The change

- `chatbot-enhanced` declares `surface?: ChatbotSurface` on its inline schema-extension type and forwards `schema.surface` to the enhanced component. The union is **imported** from `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` rather than re-spelled, so there is one contract and not two dialects that can drift (AGENTS.md #0.1).
- The key joins that registration's `inputs` (designer + autocomplete surface) with `defaultValue: 'card'`, and deliberately **not** its `defaultProps` — mirroring `processVisibility`, so nothing materializes the key onto new nodes.
- **The absent case is unchanged.** An unauthored `surface` is forwarded as `undefined`, so the component's own `surface = 'card'` default still applies.
- `chatbot` and `chatbot-floating` do **not** gain the key — they render different components with no such chrome — so the docs row is now scoped to say the key applies to the enhanced registration. The ruling's words: "the table never again claims more than the registrations deliver."

## Tests, and the reverse verification

`renderer.surface.test.tsx` pins both directions through the real SDUI host (not a bare component render), and asserts the **rendered chrome** rather than the forwarded prop — so a regression where the key is forwarded but no longer acted on is still red.

Ablation, to prove the pin measures the wiring rather than itself. No rebuild was needed and the reason is load-bearing: the test imports `../renderer` and `./ChatbotEnhanced` **relatively**, so no `dist` is in the resolution path for the mutated file.

- Mutation: removed the `surface` forward. **Confirmed on disk** — removed-text count 1 to 0, control `processVisibility` forward still 1, `git diff --stat` one deletion.
- Result: **RED in the expected direction** — the `'plain'` case failed with `Received: "flex min-h-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-background"`, i.e. it kept the card chrome. The other 4 cases stayed green, which is correct: they do not depend on the forward.
- Restore leg proven twice, not by an exit code: `git diff HEAD` empty **and** `git hash-object` equal to the HEAD blob.

## Gates run (measured on the final commit `d6391c838`)

| gate | verdict line |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check` | green (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/` | `Test Files 29 passed (29)` / `Tests 391 passed (391)` |
| `check:control-bytes` | `check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 5649 tracked text file(s))` |
| `check:docs-route-closure` | `1353 modules crawled from 148 route roots (144 MDX), every specifier resolved` |
| `check:designer-field-key-parity` | exit 0 |
| `check:spec-symbols` | exit 0 |
| `check:esm-specifiers` | exit 0 |
| `check-changeset-presence` | `2 source file(s) ... declares 1 changeset(s)` |
| `eslint . --no-inline-config` (full repo, not narrowed) | 3954 files; my 2 source files add **0 errors, 0 new warnings** (renderer.tsx carries the same 3 pre-existing `no-explicit-any`, 3 on base and 3 on head) |

`tsconfig.json` for this package **excludes** `**/*.test.tsx`, so "typecheck is clean" would have said nothing about the new test. Verified it is genuinely covered: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` matches `renderer.surface.test.tsx` once.

Two gates report NOT MEASURED locally rather than green or red, and neither is a failure:
- `check:sdui-registration-pins` needs a built console (exit 2, "not a pass ... Build the console first"). Its derived population is 12 keys, all from `layout` and `app-shell` — `plugin-chatbot` is not in it, so this diff is outside what it weighs. CI runs it regardless.
- `check:readme-exports` reported its own population collapse (`packagesRead 9, floor 25`, 28 unbuilt) — a prerequisite state of this container, not a verdict on this diff.
